audience: inventory and purchasing teams who manage stock, customers and orders in SOS Inventory

useCases.title: Check stock availability
useCases.text: Find an item by SKU and inspect its quantities, including stock on hand and available stock at a selected location.

useCases.title: Review outstanding orders
useCases.text: List open sales orders and purchase orders, then inspect a selected order and its line items to see shipped or received quantities.

useCases.title: Prepare a purchase order
useCases.text: Find an existing vendor and items, confirm quantities and costs, then create a purchase order for the requested goods.
